top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Evidence shows that a caregiver used inappropriate discipline on their own child while in care.  Employee was terminated.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation and found to be deficient. Based on interviews with children and daycare staff, it was determined a caregiver used profane language towards children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §746.3503(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver in the toddler room was observed changing diapers on the main clasroom rug that the children play on with no mat underneath the child.

top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a child's diaper.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were sending and receiving personal text messages while caring for children.
